d:
Pashchim bangal aur nepal ki sima se sata bihar ka kishanganj bharat ke un chuninda zilon men shamil hai jahan musalmanon ki aabadi 60 fisad se adhik hai. ye bharat ke sabse garib aur pichhre zilon men bhi shamil hain. shaikshanik aur aarthik taur par pichhre is zile ke zamini mudde kya hain? yahi samajhne ke lie bibisi sanvaddata dilanvaz pasha ne sthaniy logon se bat ki.
Vidiyo: shahanvaz ahmad
• bibisi hindi se aap in soshal midiya chainals par bhi jur sakte hain-
